coverageRule: No whole-clause coverage is implied. Explicit profiles and line hashes let independent auditor combine typed facts with numeric/prose/backend predicates. Binary-binding checks are schema qualification only.
limits: No prose-source authenticity, relevance or standard applicability inferred.
Finite manually declared semantic-role aliases; checker does not invent role semantics from variable names.
Metadata precision/unit/trap attachment is distinct from numerical correctness/refusal behavior.
Power-vs-energy envelope and metric-label profiles surface interface/metadata limitations, not standalone proof of incorrect numeric conversions.
Declared integer may use floating ABI; runtime integral-value guards remain separate.
No generated-code execution or hosted model calls.
